reply.text: {"say":"Leg day it is: a squat-pattern lift first, then a hinge, a single-leg movement, and a machine finisher for the quads.","title":"Leg Day","days":[{"name":"Leg Day","exercises":[{"key":"barbell-back-squat","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Brace hard and hit depth you control."},{"key":"barbell-romanian-deadlift","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Hinge at the hips, feel the hamstrings stretch."},{"key":"dumbbell-bulgarian-split-squat","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Keep the front shin mostly upright."},{"key":"leg-extension-machine","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause briefly at the top of each rep."},{"key":"seated-leg-curl-machine","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Slow the lowering phase."},{"key":"barbell-calf-raise","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top."}]}],"unmet":[]}
